issue.title: Repair published bead-page commit links that bare-label non-primary repos
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-e8.6 (epic sase-e8) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP; verified independently by the sase-e8 land agent and NOT caused by that epic.

`sase doctor -C project.bead_pages -j` reports ERROR: '5 published commit link(s) misattributed to the primary repository', next step 'Run `sase bead pages refresh --write`.'. The five findings span two unrelated lineages, both predating epic sase-e8:

- sase/repos/beads/pages/sase-b5/README.md: `218e78c` and `4905691` link to https://github.com/sase-org/sase--plans/commit/...
- sase/repos/beads/pages/sase-b5/sase-b5.1.md: `218e78c` links to the same sase--plans commit
- sase/repos/beads/pages/sase-b7/README.md and sase-b7/sase-b7.1.md: `ee287b0` links to https://github.com/sase-org/sase-core/commit/...

The URLs are right and the labels are wrong. I confirmed each commit really does live in the repo its URL names: `git log -1 ee287b0` resolves in the sase-core linked checkout ('feat!: materialize VCS-backed artifact files') and fails in the primary sase checkout, and `218e78c` resolves in the plans sidecar ('docs: add missing prompt backlinks') and fails in the primary. Per the invariant documented in _check_bead_page_commit_links (src/sase/doctor/checks_beads.py:65) a bare short-SHA label claims the primary repository, so a bare label whose href points at a sidecar or linked remote is a rendering defect: the label should be repo-qualified.

Scope: decide whether the projection that writes published pages still bare-labels non-primary commits (fix it if so) or whether these pages are merely stale bytes from an older projection, then republish the affected pages so `sase doctor` returns OK. Note the recommended remedy writes to the shared beads sidecar repo, which is an outward-facing publish; the sase-e8 land agent deliberately left that to the project owner.
